narrative.overview: The product is a carbon-copy register of the engine's recommendations, not a dashboard. Every store is a stub with a perforated edge; the engine's reason prints as the stub's ruled fields; every verdict prints as a stamp. The magenta ACT NOW stamp marks every store that needs a human decision; approved records take the green stamp, and nothing is ever erased, it cancels. Color does named form jobs: indigo owns the masthead band and register ink, green owns only the live system, magenta exists solely to stamp act-now. Depth is stock sitting on stock - no shadows anywhere - and nothing eases: state changes step. This second user-commissioned world replaced the quieter shelf-label world the user judged 'a little bit same.'
keyCharacteristics: One signature moment per stub: the double-ring magenta ACT NOW stamp, pressed askew (-2deg).
Full-bleed #2a1b6a masthead band with the white wordmark and the green LED rail.
Perforation punches open every store stub; hairlines rule every field.
Carbon figures print in IBM Plex Mono; all other text prints in TESCOModern - the files dunnhumby.com self-hosts.
Sharp corners (0-2px), flat stock-on-stock depth, stepped motion that never eases.

rules.name: The Stamp Rule
rules.body: One stamp per stub, and the state it prints never vanishes - approval stamps GREEN, nothing erases, it cancels. #cf348d prints only where the meaning is "act now".

rules.name: The Carbon Rule
rules.body: All live figures print in IBM Plex Mono carbon ink, always tabular. Space Grotesk is reserved for nameplates; Roboto carries prose.

rules.name: The Stock-on-Stock Rule
rules.body: No shadows anywhere on the shelf. Depth is paper on stock separated by hairlines, with perforations and ruled fields.

rules.name: The Only-Frame Rule
rules.body: Stubs wear 1px hairlines. Exactly one element per surface may carry a 2px colored frame: the ACTION REQUIRED form head. No colored border ever rides a single side of a card.

rules.name: The Deep-Ink Rule
rules.body: Words print only in deep inks (#a4285e, #0e7a55, #3b3f66, #2a1b6a); the raw trio is reserved for dots, rails, fills, and stamp bodies.

rules.name: The Quiet Voice Rule
rules.body: The register speaks in sentence case. No tracked uppercase anywhere; IBM Plex Mono carries only figures, record ids, and the token field. Urgency is stamped, not shouted.

rules.name: The Tabular Ledger Rule
rules.body: The board re-renders every 60s; every number sits in mono tabular slots so re-renders never jitter or reflow rows.

rules.name: The No-Shadow Ledger Rule
rules.body: If a state needs emphasis, it gets a stamp or a frame - never a shadow, never a lift.

dos: Do stamp verdicts - one stamp per stub, stamped in the state's ink, upright on mobile.
Do print every live figure in IBM Plex Mono with tabular numerals.
Do keep the ground warm (#f6f4ef) and plates paper (#fffdf8); depth = stock-on-stock flat.
Do carry the trio's brand jobs exactly: indigo band + ink, green live system, magenta stamps only.
donts: Don't cast a shadow - emphasis comes from stamps, frames, and paper contrast.
Don't ease anything: motion steps; no smooth sweeps or fades.
Don't shout: no tracked uppercase anywhere; stamps carry urgency by shape, not caps.
Don't put colored borders >1px on stubs or panels; the ACTION REQUIRED frame and stamp rings are the only 2px color in the system.
Don't erase history: approvals add a green stamp; error slips print and stay.
Don't invent serial numbers or fictional form copy - the register voice prints product truth only.
